estimate: About 200 hours · Difficulty 4/10 · 1 playthrough · 0 online trophies
estimateSources: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at about 200 hours; GTA-Zone and KeenGamer agree on one playthrough and zero online trophies.
missablesNote: Only one trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude (the Chapter 1 balcony meditation). Every story trophy, every stranger final and everything on the 100% checklist can be finished after the story in free roam.

stages.name: Before you start
steps: Keep cheats OFF the whole run: using any cheat disables trophies and saving (PowerPyx; GTA-Zone). Cheats only unlock after the story anyway.
Make a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so separate saves are your only backup (PowerPyx; KeenGamer).
Turn the spoiler setting ON in this guide if you want story trophies hidden until you earn them.

stages.name: Chapters 1–5: the story
steps: Play the five chapters in order. The twelve story trophies (the opening mission, chapters 1–4, the six named missions and the final mission) pop on their own and cannot be missed.

Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation right after the mission Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony and accept. It may be required for Positive Mental Attitude and is gone after Chapter 1 (PowerPyx).
Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel — Whip It Good and You WAiNKer! fill in passively if you start early.
Take optional missions as they appear. Some disappear after a while, but none of them gate a trophy (PowerPyx).

stages.name: Strangers & side characters
steps: Finish the five named-character finals: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Every trophy-related quest giver is still there in free roam after the story (PowerPyx).
Complete 8 stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not (GTA-Zone).
Bret's hunting chain is Jason-only and opens after Chapter 2; Andy's chain is Lucia-only, Tyrone's Jason-only (GTA-Zone; GTASpotter).
Answer Cal's fishing challenge when he texts after a Chapter 1 mission.

stages.name: Activities & challenges
steps: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges (The Shootist).
Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations; win 20 different races out of 40.
Grind 250 stunts (any 250 of 397) and 50 of the 80 challenges — 70 are needed for 100% completion.
Try every activity type once for Master of None; finish one arcade game; bowl at Kolt & Associates.

stages.name: Collectibles, crime & money
steps: Meditate at all 18 spots (Positive Mental Attitude) — the last needs Jason and Lucia together, after Chapter 2.
WAiNK 100 locations, complete 3 card sets, scan 100 vehicles, unfog the whole map.
Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults, one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs), an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected; steal a jet at VCIA and a tank at Mile Zero.
Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills (Yasmani pays most), spend $100,000 in shops, buy the 8 garages, register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.

stages.name: 100% completion & the platinum
steps: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story and clear what is left: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 card sets (PowerPyx; KeenGamer).
A Long Road pops at 100% — and Vice Got a Price! follows at once, since it was the last trophy left.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
